title: Shared page OG tags split: safe tags vs. content tags (password gating)
answers: Why does a password-protected shared dashboard not show title or image in link preview?
How do I add social metadata to shared dashboard or insight pages?
body:
Shared pages render two template flags in `frontend/src/exporter/index.html`:
- `add_safe_og_tags`: generic tags only (og:type, og:url, og:site_name, twitter:card). Set to `resource.insight or resource.dashboard` in `posthog/api/sharing.py:retrieve`.
- `add_og_tags`: content-revealing tags (title, description, og:image, twitter:title/description). It must be falsy when the share is a `SharingConfiguration` with `password_required`.
Any new metadata that exposes resource title, description, or screenshot must go under `add_og_tags`, never the safe block. Otherwise password-protected shares leak content to link-preview crawlers.
Both flags must be passed in every `render_template` context in `retrieve`, including the early password-unlock render, which passes `add_og_tags: None`.
applies: posthog/api/sharing.py SharingViewerPageViewSet.retrieve and the exporter index.html template
